_comment: Least-privilege IAM policy for the P3 credential (sender configuration only).
ses:SendEmail and ses:SendRawEmail are deliberately ABSENT. P3 establishes the
trusted-sender foundation and has no delivery path; granting a send permission
the application cannot use would mean a leaked credential could send mail this
deployment itself cannot. The permission is added in P5, with the send path.
Destructive identity actions are also absent — DeleteEmailIdentity in
particular. Removing a domain in this application removes only its row; the
provider identity is left in place, because recovering from an accidental or
hostile deletion means republishing DKIM records and waiting days for
Attach to the IAM user or role whose credentials are AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and
